body.label: Effect
body.html: Your Familiar lashes out at one creature within 2 units. On a success, deal 1 Piercing damage.

surges.html: Reduce the Full Manifestation dice threshold by 1. This Surge may be used only once.

rider.title: FAMILIAR — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 3 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 1 additional Mana to fully manifest your Familiar.
